generation_method: 40 domain families x 25 reusable productized mechanisms = 1,000 unique silo candidates
objective: Turn reusable BrownEye/DreamLedger factory, audit, data normalization, catalogue, evidence, fulfilment and proof substrate into a source-referenced candidate portfolio.
source_ref_meaning: Repository paths establish reusable implementation substrate only, not external market demand or proof of revenue.
conversation_heritage: trifectadossier.txt: BrownEye Tri-Fecta, sequencing and leverage
WWW.md: BrownEye Exit Bible, silo isolation, evidence, ledger, clone-winners-only

scoring_doctrine: Deterministic tag-overlap and substrate-reuse heuristic only. It does not measure market size, observed demand, conversion, profit, or revenue.

mechanisms.name: Offer and checkout friction audit
mechanisms.deliverable: prioritized funnel defects, evidence references, and a reversible correction plan
mechanisms.method: Compare offer, catalogue fields, price, CTA, checkout handoff, and fulfilment promise without production changes.

mechanisms.name: OCR-to-action dossier
mechanisms.deliverable: structured extraction, exceptions list, source links, and a review-ready next-action pack
mechanisms.method: Turn operator-supplied documents or screenshots into structured records while retaining uncertainty and source references.

mechanisms.name: Evidence and provenance audit
mechanisms.deliverable: evidence manifest, missing-proof register, source timestamps, and SHA-256 integrity receipt
mechanisms.method: Map claims to supplied sources, mark gaps and contradictions, and produce a verifiable evidence bundle without certifying unobserved facts.

mechanisms.name: Quote and price comparison brief
mechanisms.deliverable: normalized comparison table, exclusions, source timestamps, and uncertainty flags
mechanisms.method: Normalize operator-supplied quotes or permitted public price sources to expose like-for-like cost and scope differences.

mechanisms.name: Listing pack builder
mechanisms.deliverable: validated draft titles, attributes, descriptions, provenance, and listing export
mechanisms.method: Produce draft listing fields from supplied source records; reject invented stock, condition claims, or unsupported attributes.

mechanisms.name: Catalogue and metadata cleanup
mechanisms.deliverable: normalized catalogue, duplicate report, missing-field list, and before/after diff
mechanisms.method: Normalize supplied catalogue data, identify duplicates and gaps, and produce a deterministic diff without publishing edits.

mechanisms.name: Inventory and status reconciliation
mechanisms.deliverable: field mapping, dry-run diff, conflict report, and rollback instructions
mechanisms.method: Reconcile two operator-authorized exports or test endpoints and surface stock, status, identifier, or version mismatches.

mechanisms.name: Bulk price and outlier analysis
mechanisms.deliverable: batch analysis, outlier flags, source-stamped suggested values, and exception report
mechanisms.method: Analyze a supplied dataset for price gaps, stale values, unusual records, and inconsistent units; recommendations remain drafts.

mechanisms.name: Source change monitoring
mechanisms.deliverable: scheduled change summary, source timestamps, freshness status, and exception alerts
mechanisms.method: Monitor declared permitted sources for changes and emit sourced diffs; never claim completeness where access is unavailable.

mechanisms.name: Decision brief
mechanisms.deliverable: options, criteria, supporting sources, trade-offs, recommendation, and unresolved questions
mechanisms.method: Compress a bounded decision into a source-backed brief and separate observations from assumptions.

mechanisms.name: Fulfilment proof pack
mechanisms.deliverable: order-to-artifact attribution, artifact SHA-256, delivery receipt, and exception trail
mechanisms.method: Generate a consistent handoff proof bundle for an existing manual or digital delivery process without inventing a paid event.

mechanisms.name: Customer intake and scope qualifier
mechanisms.deliverable: validated intake contract, completeness checks, scope flags, and human review queue
mechanisms.method: Turn repeated intake into a bounded request with missing fields and risky assumptions surfaced before fulfilment.

mechanisms.name: Single-workflow automation setup
mechanisms.deliverable: staging workflow, event contract, failure handling, rollback plan, tests, and operator runbook
mechanisms.method: Automate one scoped workflow in test or staging first; production writes remain separately approved.

mechanisms.name: Content-to-assets repackaging
mechanisms.deliverable: channel-ready draft excerpts, metadata, summary assets, and provenance map
mechanisms.method: Transform supplied source content into bounded derivative assets and keep claims tied to the provided source.

mechanisms.name: Media metadata normalization
mechanisms.deliverable: normalized media metadata, missing-tag report, duplicate groups, and export
mechanisms.method: Normalize titles, tags, creators, version IDs, asset references, and metadata using supplied assets and permitted information.

mechanisms.name: Source-data enrichment
mechanisms.deliverable: enriched dataset with field-level source refs, timestamp, and unresolved values
mechanisms.method: Enrich a bounded dataset using allowed material; retain nulls and provenance rather than filling unknown facts.

mechanisms.name: FAQ and knowledgebase pack
mechanisms.deliverable: versioned FAQ, retrieval-ready knowledge records, and unanswered-question backlog
mechanisms.method: Convert supplied documentation and repeated questions into a versioned, source-linked knowledge pack.

mechanisms.name: Subscription and entitlement audit
mechanisms.deliverable: entitlement state map, cancellation-path checks, retry cases, and audit findings
mechanisms.method: Review supplied plan contracts for failure states, cancellation clarity, and auditable access changes without touching live accounts.

mechanisms.name: Directory profile normalization
mechanisms.deliverable: consistent draft profiles, categorized fields, source log, and stale-data flags
mechanisms.method: Normalize owner-supplied facts and permitted public data; never fabricate testimonials, ratings, or business claims.

mechanisms.name: Quote and proposal pack builder
mechanisms.deliverable: scope-normalized quote draft, assumptions, exclusions, acceptance criteria, and version history
mechanisms.method: Create editable commercial drafts from explicit operator inputs and approved pricing rules; no binding offers sent automatically.

mechanisms.name: Marketplace trust and listing packet
mechanisms.deliverable: seller evidence index, listing-quality checks, disclosed unknowns, and buyer handoff receipt
mechanisms.method: Package seller evidence and catalogue fields without claiming independent authenticity checks that were not performed.

mechanisms.name: Recurring operations report
mechanisms.deliverable: scheduled report, source freshness indicators, month-on-month changes, and exception list
mechanisms.method: Produce a recurring, source-stamped summary from an agreed dataset with visible missing-data and access-failure states.

mechanisms.name: API and export bridge
mechanisms.deliverable: field mapping, tested export/import adapter, sample payloads, retries, and rollback note
mechanisms.method: Bridge two named formats using documented APIs or test exports; secret handling and production mutation require separate authorization.

mechanisms.name: Rights and asset provenance register
mechanisms.deliverable: asset register, source/owner fields, license-status unknowns, expiry fields, and evidence links
mechanisms.method: Record declared rights and provenance evidence without legal advice or converting missing documents into clearance.

mechanisms.name: Compliance evidence readiness pack
mechanisms.deliverable: requirement-to-evidence matrix, missing-record list, versioned evidence bundle, and review questions
mechanisms.method: Organize records against a declared checklist; do not claim certification, legal advice, eligibility, or regulatory compliance.

invariants: Unique silo IDs and SKU hypotheses across the full set.
No invented checkout URLs, Stripe product/price IDs, buyers, settlement, or revenue.
All public availability, checkout, and deployment remain disabled.
All silos use the canonical shared settlement/fulfilment truth contract.
Generated lane manifests flow into the existing FactoryFactoryCompiler.readLaneManifests intake.
No public catalogue mutation, buyer contact, spend, payment, secret change, database write, or production deployment.
